texts.zh:
[From.GetName]核心内部有什么东西开始稳定地脉动，定期使地面产生轻微的颤动。那像是心跳一般的声音几乎令人感到宽慰。

但我们担心那声音可能变得越来越大。地质学家正在密切监测星球，留意危险的地质运动。
texts.en:
Something deep within the core of [From.GetName] has begun to pulsate at a steady pace, sending gentle ripples through the ground at regular intervals. It gives off a soft almost soothing sound, similar to that of a heart beating.

Concerns have been raised, however, that the sound may be growing in strength. Geologists are monitoring the planet closely for signs of dangerous seismic activity.

texts.zh:
仅仅过了一年之久，在[hatchling_egg.GetName]上新成立的殖民地就发生了一系列灾难性的大地震，将地貌变成了无法辨识的地狱景象。地表上出现许多深不见底的裂隙，有的甚至横穿整块大陆，并从地壳深处喷出硫磺气体与有毒液体。

这种地震现象通常是由地幔内的岩浆流造成的，但在[From.GetName]上根本没有地震活动，除了从地核里发出的不祥震动之外。当地行政机构已开始怀疑殖民地的长期可行性。
texts.en:
Barely a year old, the newly established colony on [hatchling_egg.GetName] has been shaken by a series of devastating earthquakes that are transforming the environment into an unrecognizable hellscape. Deep rifts, some spanning entire continents, are forming across its surface, spewing sulfuric gases and noxious liquids from deeper within the crust.

Such seismological phenomena are typically caused by magma currents in a planet's mantle but on [From.GetName] there are no indications of seismic activity at all, except for the ominous pounding from the planet's core. Local authorities are beginning to question the colony's viability in the long-term.

texts.zh:
[From.GetName]正在经历一系列地震变化，将原本美丽的环境变成了无法辨识的地狱景象。地表上出现许多深不见底的裂隙，有的甚至横穿整块大陆，并从地壳深处喷出硫磺气体与有毒液体。

卫星数据显示地核深处在发出强烈的声波能源，就好象心跳一般。
texts.en:
[From.GetName] is going through a series of rapid seismic changes that are transforming the formerly pristine environment into an unrecognizable hellscape. Deep rifts, some spanning entire continents, are forming across its surface, spewing sulfuric gases and noxious liquids from deeper within the crust.

Satellite data shows strong bursts of sonic energy pulsating from the planet's inner core, as from a heart beating.

tooltips.zh: 地震波撕裂了殖民地，摧毁了所有建筑并留下了裂隙。
tooltips.en: Seismic waves have torn through the colony, leveling all buildings and leaving Rifts in their wake.

label.zh: 蛋继续裂开（约60%）：60-160天后进入第二阶段
label.en: The egg keeps cracking (about 60%): stage 2 after 60-160 days

texts.zh:
一阵猛烈地震袭击了[hatchling_egg.GetName]，使地壳破裂并释放出大量的有毒气体与黏液，使所有生物窒息。

[hatchling_egg.GetName]上发生的变化恐怕无法复原，并且程度严重到星球近期都无法居住。当地行政机构已宣布进入紧急情况，并要求所有剩余的居民进行疏散。

与此同时，星球地核深处的脉动正在变得越来越强。
texts.en:
A shockwave of earthquakes has struck [hatchling_egg.GetName], rupturing the lithosphere and expelling a blanket of toxic gases and sludge, that is now smothering all living things.

We fear the changes on [hatchling_egg.GetName] are irreversible and substantial enough that the planet will be uninhabitable within a near future. Local authorities have declared a state of emergency and request that all remaining inhabitants be evacuated.

Meanwhile, the rhythmic pulses from the planet's core are growing in strength.

texts.zh:
又一场猛烈地震袭击了[hatchling_egg.GetName]，使地壳破裂并释放出大量的有毒气体与黏液，使所有生物窒息。

[hatchling_egg.GetName]上发生的变化无法复原，并且程度严重到星球近期都无法居住。

与此同时，星球地核深处的脉动正在变得越来越强。
texts.en:
Another shock wave of earthquakes has struck [hatchling_egg.GetName], cracking the lithosphere open and expelling more toxic gases and sludge that now blanket the surface, smothering all living things.

The changes to [hatchling_egg.GetName] are both irreversible and substantial enough to render the planet uninhabitable within a near future.

Meanwhile, the rhythmic pulses from the planet's core are growing in strength.

tooltips.zh: 地震波撕裂了殖民地，摧毁了所有建筑并留下了裂隙。
tooltips.en: Seismic waves have torn through the colony, leveling all buildings and leaving Rifts in their wake.

label.zh: 60-150天后蛋壳破裂，虚空孳孽孵出
label.en: After 60-150 days the egg cracks and the Voidspawn hatches

texts.zh: 灾难降临在了[hatchling_egg.GetName]的殖民地上！最后一波剧烈的地壳破裂彻底地撕碎了殖民地的残骸，空壳之下，一只可怕的虚空孳孽幼体如梦魇一般降临！这违背了一切常理，但也没有其它的解释。我们误以为它是颗星球，可它其实是颗蛋，而现在那颗蛋已经孵化了。
texts.en: Disaster has befallen the colony on [hatchling_egg.GetName]! A final sequence of violent ruptures has razed the last remains of the settlement and cracked the planet open, and from its empty shell is bursting the nightmarish form of a newborn Voidspawn. It goes against all sense, still there is no other way to explain it. Somehow what we mistook for a world was not a world at all, but an egg, and that egg has now hatched.

texts.zh:
[hatchling_egg.GetName]已经不存在了！最后一波剧烈的地壳破裂彻底地撕碎了这颗行星，一只巨大到难以想像的怪兽幼体从星球内破壳而出。

这违背了一切常理，但也没有其它的解释。我们误以为它是颗星球，可它其实是颗蛋，而现在一只噩梦般的虚空孳孽已经孵化了出来。
texts.en:
[hatchling_egg.GetName] is no more! A final sequence of violent ruptures has cracked the planet open and from its empty shell crawls the newborn form of a creature of unimaginable proportions.

It goes against all sense, still there is no other way of explaining it. Somehow what we mistook for a world was not a world at all, but an egg, that has now hatched a nightmarish Voidspawn into the galaxy.

label.zh: 舰队进入虚空孳孽所在的星系
label.en: A fleet enters the system where the Voidspawn lives

texts.zh: 一只巨大到难以想像的怪物，正在小心翼翼地从一颗星球移动到另一颗星球。从其别扭的比例与笨拙的身手来看，它还只是个幼崽，但仍然同样可怕。它身上粘着一丝丝的黑色黏液，利爪从其掌间伸出。无论幼崽与否，它都是一只天性凶猛的捕食者。
texts.en: A creature of unthinkable size is fluttering clumsily from planet to planet. Judging by its awkward proportions and movements it is only a spawn yet, but it is horrifying to behold all the same. Strings of slime and black bile cling to its body and sharp mandibles. Spawn or not, it is a predator, equipped to kill.

texts.zh:
虚空孳孽蜷曲的身体发出一阵轻微的震颤，黑色液体从其伤口与鼻口中泄出，接着它便消逝了，眼睛茫然地凝视着虚空。

但愿我们永远不会见到它生长至成年期的样子，或是其生母的所在之处。

我们的科学家对研究其蛋壳保留能源的独特能力表示很感兴趣。
texts.en:
A light tremor passes through the Voidspawn's curled up body, ribbons of black fluid trailing from its wounds and snout, then it is gone, its liquid eyes staring emptily into space.

Hopefully we will never know the form it might have taken if allowed to reach adulthood, or the whereabouts of its originator.

Our scientists have expressed an interest in researching the egg shards for their unique energy retaining qualities.

label.zh: 别。我们不想再与虚空孳孽有任何牵扯。
label.en: No. We are done with the Voidspawn.

texts.zh: 虚空孳孽的卵进化出了通过吸收邻近恒星的能源来忍受严酷太空环境的能力。或许这些碎片可以揭露它的秘密。
texts.en: Somehow the Voidspawn egg has evolved to survive the harsh conditions of space, by absorbing and conserving huge amounts of solar energy. Maybe the remains of the shattered shards could reveal its secrets.

texts.zh: 在仔细研究蛋壳碎片之后，我们开发出了一种科技，可以使我们的太阳能电厂获得类似虚空孳孽之卵的能源保留能力。
texts.en: A closer analysis of the egg shards has allowed us to develop a technology that will reproduce some of the Voidspawn egg's remarkable energy retaining qualities in our own solar plants.

texts.zh:
我们面临着一个抉择：

如果我们对蛋的碎片进行近距离分析，我们便有可能再现一些虚空孳孽卵的非凡的能量固存特性。

或者是我们可以保存好虚空孳孽的基因物质以备未来使用。
texts.en:
We are faced with a choice:

If we conduct a closer analysis of the egg shards, we could potentially reproduce some of the Voidspawn egg's remarkable energy retaining qualities.

Alternatively, we can preserve the genetic material of the Voidspawn for future use.

tooltips.zh: 解锁用于星神兽转基因的虚体化特质。
tooltips.en: Unlocks the Voidling trait for Leviathan Transgenesis.

title.zh: 复活被杀死的虚空孳孽

texts.zh: [Owner.GetNecromancersLower]向我们保证他们能通过某些不可告人的方式将虚空孳孽复活，并使其效力于我们，伴随在舰队旁一同战斗。
texts.en: Through methods best not spoken of aloud, our [Owner.GetNecromancersLower] assure us that they are capable of resurrecting the Voidspawn to serve us and fight alongside our fleets.

texts.zh: 我们的死灵法师将躯体装回它原来所在的卵中，孵化了新的虚空孳孽以效力于我们的事业。
texts.en: Our necromancers returned the body to the egg from which it came, and hatched the Voidspawn anew to serve our cause.

texts.zh:
将虚空孳孽装回卵中并再次将其孵化的操作竟然极其地有效。利用卵中残留的原生物质，我们的死灵[root.GetNecromancersLower]可以轻易地编辑这具躯骸来服务我们。

将这只生物制成提线木偶后，我们现在可以扇动它的翅膀了。
texts.en:
Returning the Voidspawn to its egg and incubating it again proved to be incredibly efficient. By making use of the primordial matter still inside the egg, our [root.GetNecromancersLower] easily edited the corpse to service us.

With the creature thus puppeteered, we now flex it's wings.

texts.zh: 通过实施死灵机师协议，我们可以复活已死的虚空孳孽，替代性翅膀已经由实验性生化合金铸成。
texts.en: Utilizing Mechromancy protocols, we have been able to reanimate the terminated Voidspawn. Replacement wings have been forged using an experimental bio-alloy.

texts.zh:
[hatchling_egg.GetName]上的奇怪地震活动突然停止了。不再有震动，不再有新的裂隙，不再有地核深处传来的不详脉动。星球已经彻底安静了下来，并且如果我们运气好的话，也将继续如此。

我们现在只能重建损失。
texts.en:
The strange seismic activity on [hatchling_egg.GetName] has stopped abruptly. There are no more tremors, no new rifts, no ominous pulsating from its core. The planet has grown quiet and with any luck it will stay that way.

All that remains now is to rebuild what was lost.

texts.zh: [hatchling_egg.GetName]上的奇怪地震活动突然停止了。不再有震动，不再有新的裂隙，不再有地核深处传来的不详脉动。星球已经彻底安静了下来，并且如果我们运气好的话，也将继续如此。
texts.en: The strange seismic activity on [hatchling_egg.GetName] has stopped abruptly. There are no more tremors, no new rifts, no ominous pulsating from its core. The planet has grown quiet and with any luck it will stay that way.

label.zh: 清空蛋裂缝矿藏后，行星复原
label.en: Once the egg-crack deposits are cleared the planet is restored

note.zh: 没有孵化；清除裂缝后行星复原。
note.en: No hatching; the planet is restored once the cracks are cleared.

texts.zh: [Root.GetName]上的毒性粘液已被清除，而最后一道裂隙也已被填上，以防止更多毒性液体泄漏至地表。
texts.en: The toxic sludge on [Root.GetName] has been cleared and the last rifts filled, preventing more noxious gases from leaking to the surface.

summary.text:
# 有脉搏的星球 / A Planet with a Pulse

- 分类 Category：探索 Exploration · DLC：《遥远繁星》Distant Stars（has_distar）或 Biogenesis（has_biogenesis_dlc） · 审阅 Reviewed：2026-10-13（已审阅 reviewed）
- 来源 Sources：common/solar_system_initializers/distant_stars_initializers.txt:1178 (guardians_init_hatchling; egg planet 1230-1238); common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:1306 (on_colonized → distar.5000); common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:103 (on_monthly_pulse → distar.5001); events/distant_stars_events_3.txt:15-340 (distar.5000-5006); events/distant_stars_events_3.txt:491 (distar.5007); events/distant_stars_events_3.txt:553 (distar.5013); events/distant_stars_events_3.txt:685 (distar.5014, 5015); events/distant_stars_events_3.txt:775 (distar.5011); common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:1006; events/distant_stars_events_3.txt:815 (distar.5009); common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:1655; events/distant_stars_events_3.txt:971 (distar.5016); events/distant_stars_events_3.txt:1045 (distar.5012)

## 如何开始 How it starts

拥有《遥远繁星》或 Biogenesis 时，银河生成一个“虚空孳孽系统”（guardians_init_hatchling，最多1个），其中有一颗虚空孳孽卵星球（rl_voidspawn_egg，标志 hatchling_egg，初始化时60%带 hatchling_will_trigger）。有人殖民该星球（on_colonized → distar.5000），约200-300天后触发 distar.5010；若只是占有系统而不殖民，月度检查 distar.5001 也会在约200-300天后直接启动第一阶段（distar.5002）。

With Distant Stars or Biogenesis the galaxy spawns a Voidspawn system (guardians_init_hatchling, at most one) with an egg planet (rl_voidspawn_egg, flag hatchling_egg; 60% get hatchling_will_trigger at spawn). When someone colonises it (on_colonized → distar.5000), distar.5010 fires after about 200-300 days; if they only own the system, the monthly check distar.5001 starts stage 1 (distar.5002) directly after about 200-300 days.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

1. distar.5010“有脉搏的星球”：星球核心开始有规律地脉动。
2. 约100-150天后（distar.5002）：星球外观变化，获得三个 d_egg_cracking 矿藏和 seismological_phenomena 修正，所有者收到 distar.5003“异形魔怪”（地震）。
3. 此后二选一：约60%（hatchling_will_trigger）60-160天后进入 distar.5004/5005“大灾变”（第二阶段，毒气覆盖）；约40%则30-90天后收到 distar.5013“[hatchling_egg.GetName]上的地震活动”。
4. 大灾变之后60-150天：distar.5006 摧毁殖民地，星球变为 pc_egg_cracked 并获得 d_society_10 矿藏；所有者收到 distar.5007“起源”；70天后虚空孳孽（guardian_hatchling 国家与首领舰队）诞生并在系统中巡逻（distar.5008）。
5. 首次进入该星系 → distar.5011“虚空孳孽”（建立通讯，15天后 story.8）。击毁它 → distar.5009“虚空孳孽被击败”：三选项——a启用项目 SHATTERED_EGG（蛋壳碎片，→ distar.5012“超体进化”：科技 tech_gargantuan_evolution 30%，可收集 DNA）；b直接获得团结加成；死灵师可启用项目 REANIMATE_VOIDSPAWN → distar.5016“逝者复生”（一支复活的虚空孳孽舰队）。结束时开始“利维坦庆典”情境。
6. 另一支：蛋被打断（5013）后，清除蛋裂缝矿藏时 distar.5014 恢复星球外观并显示 distar.5015“完好如初”。

1. distar.5010 "A Planet with a Pulse": the planet's core starts pulsating at a steady pace.
2. About 100-150 days later (distar.5002): the planet's look changes, it gains three d_egg_cracking deposits and the seismological_phenomena modifier, and the owner gets distar.5003 "Tremors" (earthquakes).
3. Then one of two: about 60% (hatchling_will_trigger) go on 60-160 days later to distar.5004/5005 "Cataclysm" (stage 2, toxic gases); about 40% receive distar.5013 "Seismic Activity on [hatchling_egg.GetName]" (the quakes stop) after 30-90 days.
4. 60-150 days after the Cataclysm: distar.5006 destroys the colony, the planet becomes pc_egg_cracked with d_society_10 deposits, and the owner gets distar.5007 "Genesis"; 70 days later the Voidspawn (a guardian_hatchling country and boss fleet) is born and patrols the system (distar.5008).
5. Entering the system the first time → distar.5011 "Voidspawn" (contact established, story.8 15 days later). Destroying it → distar.5009 "Voidspawn Defeated": a starts project SHATTERED_EGG (egg shards → distar.5012 "Gargantuan Evolution": 30% of tech_gargantuan_evolution, DNA can be harvested), b takes the unity bonus directly; necromancers can start project REANIMATE_VOIDSPAWN → distar.5016 "Rise Again" (a reanimated Voidspawn fleet). It ends by starting a Leviathan celebration situation.
6. Side branch: after the egg is interrupted (5013), clearing the egg-crack deposits makes distar.5014 restore the planet's look and show distar.5015 "As Good as New".

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

5003 之后“继续裂开”与“停止”互斥（约60/40，生成时决定）；击败后的 5009 选项 a/b/死灵师三选一；不是必须击败虚空孳孽——它只是巡逻的首领舰队。

After 5003 "keeps cracking" and "stops" are exclusive (about 60/40, decided at spawn); the 5009 options a / b / necromancer are alternatives; defeating the Voidspawn is optional — it is a boss fleet on patrol.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

各通知事件（5003/5005/5007/5013）只发给蛋星球的所有者或系统所有者，正文随星球是否被殖民变化；5012/5016 的正文与选项随 DNA 收集能力、蜂巢/机械状态变化。

The notices (5003/5005/5007/5013) go only to the egg planet's or system's owner and their text depends on whether the planet is colonised; 5012/5016 vary with DNA harvesting and hive/machine status.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

已核对初始化器、on_colonized/on_monthly_pulse/on_entering_system_fleet/on_fleet_destroyed_perp 触发与 distar.5000–5016。修正：草稿把 5003/5005/5007/5013 都挂在 5010 下并归为同一互斥组，且把进入、击毁、复原各作独立故事（event-distar-5001/5009/5011/5014）；现合为一个以 distar.5010 为起点的故事，用审阅连接还原顺序（5003→5005→5007→5011→5009）并把 5013 作为与 5005 互斥的分支。distar.5000/5001/5002/5004/5006/5008/5014 是隐藏事件，不作为章节。

Checked the initializer, the on_colonized / on_monthly_pulse / on_entering_system_fleet / on_fleet_destroyed_perp hooks and distar.5000-5016. Correction: the draft hung 5003/5005/5007/5013 all under 5010 as one exclusive group and made entering, killing and restoring separate stories (event-distar-5001/5009/5011/5014); they are now one story from distar.5010 with reviewed links restoring the order (5003 → 5005 → 5007 → 5011 → 5009), with 5013 as the branch exclusive with 5005. distar.5000/5001/5002/5004/5006/5008/5014 are hidden events, not chapters.
